metadata.title: University of Michigan–Ann Arbor 新生办理与到校任务清单
metadata.scope: 面向 Ann Arbor 校区新生，重点覆盖报到后常见的身份证件、校园参访、学费、国际学生签证服务、医疗、银行、手机和可选 SSN。
source_priority: third-party local listings only when official pages did not expose a needed local detail
metadata.data_quality_note: 营业时间和政策可能因假日、学期、临时调整而变化。涉及必须亲自到场的事项，建议出发当天再次打开 source_url 核实。

where.name: MCard Issuing Station – Michigan Union Tech Shop
where.address: Ground Level, Michigan Union, 530 S State St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109

where.name: MCard Issuing Station – Pierpont Commons
where.address: Suite 2202, Pierpont Commons, 2101 Bonisteel Blvd, Ann Arbor, MI 48109

what_to_bring: Government-issued photo ID for a first-time MCard; the ID must be unexpired, valid, and contain photo, name, date of birth, and signature.
If you submitted an online MCard photo, bring/check the email instructions telling you how to obtain the card.
If you have a previous MCard, bring/return it as applicable; otherwise a replacement fee may apply.
tasks.cost: New student MCard is no cost; returning students with an existing valid student MCard can continue using it until expiration. A $20 replacement fee may apply in certain replacement situations.
notes: New students do not normally use the Shared Services Center for MCard pickup; the official page specifically says new students who submitted photos online should follow the email instructions and should not use SSC.
Student MCards are valid for five years.
Online photo submission is available for new Ann Arbor students.

tasks.task: 参加 U-M 官方 Central Campus Tour

where.name: U-M Office of Undergraduate Admissions – official in-person campus tour

tasks.route_note: The current official Admissions pages confirm a 75-minute Central Campus walking tour but do not publish a fixed start/end location in the text available to this search. Do not infer a meeting point from the self-guided campus map. Check the appointment/registration confirmation for the exact meeting point on the day.
what_to_bring: Weather-appropriate clothing; most of the tour is outdoors.
Comfortable walking shoes.
Registration confirmation / appointment details.
notes: Party size is limited to four total people.
Arriving more than 10 minutes late means the group will have departed; a self-guided walking tour map is provided instead.
The standard tour includes a model residence-hall room but not a dining-hall visit.
Accessibility needs can be entered during registration.

tasks.task: 确认 2026-27 学费 / 学生账单

where.primary: Wolverine Access → Student Business / eBill for the student's actual bill
where.in_person_support: Student Financial Services, 2226 Student Activities Building, 515 E Jefferson St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109-1316

2026_2027_reference_costs.population: Ann Arbor undergraduate, LSA reference, 15-credit semester basis
2026_2027_reference_costs.note: U-M Facts & Figures lists these as 2026-27 tuition + fees reference figures; program-specific rates can differ.

2026_2027_reference_costs.population: International undergraduate, LSA lower division (0-54 credits toward program)
2026_2027_reference_costs.note: U-M Admissions states these 2026-27 figures are based on approved rates and use LSA as the reference program.

2026_2027_reference_costs.population: International undergraduate, LSA upper division (55+ credits toward program)
2026_2027_reference_costs.note: U-M Admissions states these 2026-27 figures are based on approved rates and use LSA as the reference program.

what_to_bring: For an in-person Student Financial Services transaction: UMID number plus valid photo ID.
For Teller Services, U-M's FAQ states two valid IDs are required, preferably MCard + driver's license or passport.
notes: The exact tuition assessment depends on school/college, program, residency, credits, and fees; use the student's actual Wolverine Access bill as the authoritative amount.
U-M's FAQ states the university does not accept credit cards directly for student tuition bills.
Bills are delivered electronically through Wolverine Access.

tasks.task: International Center / ISSS 签证与身份服务
tasks.required: F-1/J-1 students: relevant/required depending on task

where.name: U-M International Center
where.address: 1500 Student Activities Building, 515 E Jefferson St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109-1316

hours.special_closure: Closed 08:30-11:00 on the fourth Tuesday of each month for staff meetings
hours.holidays: Closed on official U-M holidays and season days

tasks.appointment: Most requests should be submitted through M-Passport; requests that cannot be submitted there may be submitted in person during open office hours.
what_to_bring: Passport.
Most recent I-94.
I-20 (F-1) or DS-2019 (J-1), when relevant to the request.
Any task-specific documents or forms requested in M-Passport.
notes: ISSS is U-M's main point of contact for F-1 and J-1 student issues.
For Fall 2026 new students, the mandatory immigration check-in is virtual: complete the International Center Canvas check-in course and submit scanned immigration documents.
Do not assume an in-person visit is necessary; check M-Passport first.

tasks.task: U-M University Health Service (UHS / UHC Medical Services)

where.name: UHC Medical Services (University Health Service / UHS)

tasks.appointment: Appointments are required for both in-person and virtual clinician visits.
what_to_bring: MCard / student ID and your relevant insurance information, if applicable.
For the first clinician appointment, UHC says it is helpful to hand-carry a hard copy of your health history.
Do not email health-history documents in advance unless UHC specifically asks; the UHC records page says to hand-carry a hard copy to the first appointment.
notes: Most medical services are free for enrolled U-M students, though not every service is free.
Use the patient portal to self-schedule or request appointments; call 734-764-8320 if needed.
Parking can be difficult during the school year; the closest parking structures include Fletcher Street Structure and Palmer Structure.

tasks.international_center_note: U-M International Center recommends checking that an imported phone is unlocked and U.S.-compatible. It notes international students commonly consider prepaid options such as Mint Mobile, Tello, or T-Mobile, and that eSIMs may not provide a U.S. phone number.

tasks.task: 申请 Social Security Number (SSN) — 仅在符合条件时
tasks.eligibility_note: For an international student, the common student pathway is tied to authorized employment. U-M ISSS says you must have applied for an SSN if you are employed in the U.S. or have received and plan to accept an offer of employment in the U.S.
steps: 1. If you are a U-M F-1/J-1 student with a job, request the Social Security Letter from the International Center.

2. For the U-M F-1 student SSN letter, employer completes the employer section; bring the original employer letter, photocopies of I-20 pages 1-2, and your most recent I-94 to the International Center.
3. Allow 5 working days for the U-M SSN letter request to be processed.
4. Complete the SSA online application and schedule the SSA appointment.
5. Attend the SSA appointment with original/certified required documents.

where.international_center_for_letter: 1500 Student Activities Building, 515 E Jefferson St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109
where.ssa_office: 3971 Research Park Drive, Ann Arbor, MI 48108

hours.ssa: Commonly listed as Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00; verify through the SSA Office Locator for the appointment date.

what_to_bring: Original employer letter / U-M SSN letter package as directed.
Passport.
Most recent I-94.
I-20 for F-1 or DS-2019 for J-1, as applicable.
Any additional original/certified immigration documents requested by SSA.
notes: SSA says starting the online application before an in-person visit can make the visit faster.
SSA states original or certified documents are required for the document review.
The SSN card is mailed after processing; it is not printed at the office.
SSN is not a prerequisite for every bank account or every phone plan; it is best treated as an employment-related task rather than a universal arrival task.

tasks.task: 完成 Fall 2026 Mandatory Immigration Check-in
steps: Enroll in the Fall 2026 International Center Canvas Check-in Course.
Submit scanned copies of the required immigration documents through the course instructions.
what_to_bring: Passport and immigration documents in digital form, following the course's document list.
notes: This is virtual for Fall 2026; it is not necessary to travel to the International Center just to complete this check-in.

recommended_execution_order.why: MCard is useful for campus access, identity, transportation-related services, and many campus transactions.
Complete the Fall 2026 immigration check-in promptly so your immigration-status compliance task is recorded.
Use M-Passport first; visit in person only when the request requires it.
Set up UHC/patient-portal access early and know where to go before you become sick.
A U.S. number is useful for banking, account recovery, and everyday services; do this soon after arrival if your current SIM is not practical.
Open a checking account after you have a U.S. address; the exact SSN requirement depends on the bank/account.
Check the actual Wolverine Access eBill and payment status; use SFS in person only if account support is needed.
Do this only after you have a qualifying employment situation and the required U-M/SSA paperwork.
Useful for orientation, but optional once you are already a U-M student.
